### Stewart Strengthens Title Capabilities Through Acquisition of ProTitleUSA and DocSolutionUSA


Sep 01, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s27.q4cdn.com/679580685/files/doc_news/Stewart-Strengthens-Title-Capabilities-Through-Acquisition-of-ProTitleUSA-and-DocSolutionUSA-2026.pdf)


*By adding title analytics, portfolio diligence, and real estate document generation capability, Stewart enhances its capital markets and servicing capabilities*


HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Stewart Information Services Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.stewart.com%2Fen%2Fcustomer-type%2Fmortgage-lenders%3Futm_source%3DBusinessWire%26utm_medium%3DPress%2BRelease%26utm_campaign%3DProTitle&esheet=54597093&newsitemid=20260901648597&lan=en-US&anchor=Stewart+Information+Services+Corporation&index=1&md5=c7d199280fc9ab96cf040769521224f4) (NYSE: STC) today announced it has acquired ProTitleUSA (ProTitle) and DocSolutionUSA (DocSolution), two companies that together provide a comprehensive suite of title, mortgage related documents and due diligence services that support servicers, investors and capital markets clients throughout the real estate and mortgage lifecycle.


“Both of these companies bring specialized expertise that aligns with Stewart’s long-term strategy for our centralized title services,” said Fred Eppinger, Stewart CEO. “Together with our existing offerings these businesses expand our scale in title services, strengthen our lender and servicer offerings for investors and capital market clients and add innovative analytic and document generation capabilities that are highly complementary to our existing platform.”


“We are excited to welcome the teams to Stewart as we continue building high-quality, scalable solutions for all our mortgage and real estate customers,” said Beth Fowler, President of Stewart Lender Services. “By combining complementary title, document, and transaction capabilities, we're helping customers execute faster, reduce complexity, and manage risk across the full asset lifecycle.”


“ProTitle and DocSolution were built around a commitment to service, innovation and helping customers unlock additional transaction value through analytics, product creation, and automation,” said Alex Goldovsky, CEO of ProTitleUSA and DocSolutionUSA. “Joining Stewart gives us the opportunity to expand that mission with the financial strength, resources and industry reach of one of the most respected companies in real estate services. We are proud of what our teams have built and excited for the next chapter as we work together to deliver even greater value to our customers.”


Solomon Partners served as exclusive financial advisor to ProTitleUSA and DocSolutionUSA.


**About Stewart**


Stewart (NYSE-STC) is a global real estate services company, offering products and services through our direct operations, network of Stewart Trusted Providers™ and family of companies. From residential and commercial title insurance and closing and settlement services to specialized offerings for the mortgage and real estate industries, we offer the comprehensive service, deep expertise and solutions our customers need for any real estate transaction. At Stewart, we are dedicated to becoming the premier title services company and we are committed to doing so by partnering with our customers to create mutual success. Learn more at[stewart.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.stewart.com%2Fen.html&esheet=54597093&newsitemid=20260901648597&lan=en-US&anchor=stewart.com&index=2&md5=03ab0b3046cbbd2638261cd65cc20dfc) .
